patch_description: Add a cheap shortest-path routing signal to move screening. It routes demand under four deterministic tie-breakings and ranks moves by a high-percentile peak-load estimate, making the signal less sensitive to a single arbitrary choice among tied shortest paths. The signal is only one part of selection: energy-ranked moves retain a quota, routing-ranked moves get a smaller quota, and a random fresh move preserves exploration. Thus the routing estimate guides LP-call allocation without acting as a hard filter.
